scope: Actual shipped EOS Admin React frontend; synthetic authenticated HTTP/WebSocket and in-memory persistence; no real controller or appliance

scenarios.name: desktop
checks: System/Expert controls remain reachable while long adapter navigation scrolls
Visible System and Expert controls; expert session mode enables and disables
Native system settings open and retain customer/site and location fields
Synthetic save failure preserves edits and releases Save button for retry
Save persists customer/site name and preserves location
Discard leaves stored configuration unchanged
Native EOS licensing tab renders valid Home status
License request failure removes stale confirmation and refresh restores status
Synthetic activation sends same-origin guarded request, displays Pro, clears input, does not persist code in browser storage
License removal requires confirmation; cancel sends nothing; confirm shows unlicensed status
No floating standalone license link remains
Authenticated policy downgrade removes administrator controls immediately
